name: How do I choose the right contractor for a multi-room renovation?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for a multi-room renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Look for a contractor who provides transparent communication, hands-on jobsite management, and verified trade craftsmanship. When multiple rooms are involved, having a single point of contact who leads on-site carpentry, drywall, and tile while managing electrical and plumbing sub-trades keeps the schedule on track. Verify their licensing, insurance, and Better Business Bureau accreditation. Checking portfolios for consistent finish details—such as crisp molding joints, straight tile lines, and smooth drywall finishing—ensures they deliver high-standard results across all spaces.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose an accredited, insured contractor with an on-site lead who coordinates sub-trades directly and demonstrates strong drywall, tile, and trim craftsmanship.
